ctaHeading: Ready for Quality Carpentry in Melbourne?
aboutText: Lumer Carpentry has been providing exceptional carpentry services in Melbourne for over a decade. Specialising in custom decks, pergolas, and renovations, we take pride in our attention to detail and quality workmanship. Our team works closely with clients to bring their visions to life, using premium materials and meticulous care.
servicesText: From custom decking to pergolas and full renovations, Lumer Carpentry offers a comprehensive range of services. We specialise in creating functional and beautiful timber structures that enhance your property.

services.title: Decking
services.desc: We design and build custom decks using high-quality timber, perfect for outdoor living and entertaining.

services.title: Pergolas
services.desc: Our pergolas are crafted to provide shade and style, tailored to complement your home's architecture.

services.title: Framing
services.desc: Expert timber framing services for new builds and extensions, ensuring structural integrity and precision.

services.title: Renovations
services.desc: Complete carpentry renovations, from kitchens to entire home makeovers, with a focus on quality finishes.

services.title: Custom Carpentry
services.desc: Bespoke carpentry solutions including built-in furniture, cabinetry, and unique timber features.

services.title: Timber Stairs
services.desc: Beautifully designed timber stairs that combine safety, functionality, and aesthetic appeal.
